title: From macro to micro: Economic complexity indicators for firm growth
abstract: arXiv:2507.21754v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A rich theoretical and empirical literature has investigated the link between export diversification and firm performance. Prior theoretical works hinted at the key role of capability accumulation in shaping production activities and performance, without however producing product-level indicators able to forecast corporate growth. Building on economic complexity theory and the corporate growth literature, this paper examines which characteristics of a firm's export basket anticipate future performance. We analyze a unique longitudinal dataset that covers export and financial data for 57,586 Italian firms. We find that firms exporting products typically exported by wealthier countries -- a proxy for products characterized by a greater level of productivity and sophistication -- tend to experience higher growth and labour productivity. Crucially, where firms diversify matters: Across firms, only diversification outside of a firm's core

translated_title: 从宏观到微观：用于企业增长的经济复杂性指标
translated_abstract: 丰富的理论与实证文献已对出口多元化与企业绩效之间的联系进行了研究。先前的理论工作暗示了能力积累在塑造生产活动和绩效方面的关键作用，但未能提出能够预测企业增长的产品层面指标。本文基于经济复杂性理论和企业增长文献，考察企业出口组合的哪些特征能够预示未来绩效。我们分析了一个独特的纵向数据集，涵盖57,586家意大利企业的出口和财务数据。我们发现，出口通常由较富裕国家出口的产品——即代表具有更高生产率和复杂程度的产品——的企业，往往拥有更高的增长和劳动生产率。至关重要的是，企业在何处实现多元化也十分关键：在企业之间，只有超出企业核心业务的多元化……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将经济复杂性指标从宏观层面应用到企业微观层面，利用57,586家意大利企业的数据发现，出口较富裕国家所出口的高生产率、高复杂度产品，并在企业核心业务之外实现多元化，能够预示企业未来更高的增长和劳动生产率。
en_tdlr: This paper bridges economic complexity from the macro to the micro level, showing with data on 57,586 Italian firms that exporting products typically exported by wealthier countries—and diversifying beyond a firm's core business—predicts higher firm growth and labor productivity.
